changelog: **A standing 1:1: a recurring meeting on a mentorship relation, with an interval and an end** (#2013, slice 1 — engine and API). `MeetingSeries` gains `relationId` (exactly one of `projectId`/`relationId`, enforced through the shared `countContexts()` Meeting already uses), `intervalWeeks` (1–8, default 1), `anchorDate`, `untilDate` and `maxOccurrences` — all additive. The cadence rule is `src/lib/seriesRule.ts` (pure, `scripts/test/series-rule.test.mjs`): intervals count whole calendar weeks from the anchor week, so a biweekly rule cannot drift across DST (pinned end to end in `e2e/series-cadence.unit.spec.ts`, 09:30 Berlin across 2026-10-25); `untilDate` is inclusive and `maxOccurrences` counts from the anchor; neither = until cancelled, the old behaviour. Every expansion reads it through `SERIES_RULE_SELECT` + `ruleOccurrences()`/`nextRuleOccurrence()` (calendar, ICS feed, dashboard banner, reminder cron, occurrence end, Google mirror — whose RRULE now carries `INTERVAL` and an inclusive `UNTIL`, never `COUNT`). `/api/meeting-series` accepts `relationId`: `ensureRelationAccess()` beside `ensureProjectAccess()` — the relation's mentor or an ADMIN write, its mentee reads, anyone else gets a 404; a standing 1:1 is a `mentorship` write, a project call still a `projects` one (gate first, as before); a series never switches context. Both participants see a relation series on `/api/calendar-events` and the ICS feed, each naming the other person. Still a rule, never rows (#1110). No user-facing control yet (so no release note): slice 2 (#2013) adds the "Make this recurring" control on the relation page, the mentee's announcement/reminders and banner for relation series, and the Google mirror audience for them. e2e: `e2e/meeting-series-relation.spec.ts`.
